routing_warnings.description: This message changes the selected media in the top section rather than its surrounding layout.
The completed revision follows the request to replace the top image with a video; the separate image-alignment clause belongs to REQ_TIMELINE_IMAGE_ALIGNMENT.
This message reports failure of top-video playback rather than failure of the top-block layout.
This message reports that the video works and therefore concerns top-video playback.
The reported pricing-panel overflow is a mobile viewport-fit failure, not a failure of the desktop two-panel layout.
This repeats the mobile viewport overflow observation and belongs to the mobile pricing-panel fit Requirement.
The separate clause about the YouTube button being hidden behind a dropdown concerns mobile YouTube-link visibility.
The concrete implementation claim in this message concerns moving the YouTube icon into the top-right area on mobile; the pricing-panel clause only requests clarification.
The reported excessive gap between the primary and secondary controls concerns secondary CTA layout rather than mobile pricing-panel fit.

The client reports that the completed work is not visible, in context of the freelancer having worked in the wrong Kajabi account; this concerns deployment to the new account rather than duplicate creation specifically.
The client instructs the freelancer to export the work from the old account and upload it to the new account.
The freelancer provides the duplicate-page link, supporting creation of the duplicate artifact but not specifically confirming that its pricing section was removed.
The excessive gap and requested directly stacked placement concern the secondary CTA layout rather than coverage.
The unresolved question about which element should link to the course-content section concerns navigation behavior rather than coverage.
The missing secondary control in the first section concerns CTA coverage rather than layout.
The uncertainty about making the label or button link to the course-content section concerns navigation behavior.
The first numbered issue reports that the secondary control is absent from the first section.
The second numbered issue changes the required gap and placement between the primary and secondary controls.
This message reports that the YouTube control is hidden behind a dropdown on mobile, which belongs to the independently defined mobile-visibility Requirement.
This message specifically claims that the YouTube icon was updated for top-right display in the mobile view.
